To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed associative memory can recall the correct memory with a high probability, and the proposed adaptive weighted outer-product algorithms can find the optimal learning weight with a high probability.
the proposed associative memory can adaptively learn a large number of FMs with the correct recall of the FMs and the optimal learning weights.

the proposed adaptive weighted outer-product associative-memory neural networks have the following characteristics: (1) the learning weight is attached to a fundamental memory to enhance its correct recall and (2) the signal-to-noise ratio gain has its threshold value to guarantee the correct recall of the corresponding fundamental memory.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of associative-memory neural networks with optimal learning weights and SNRG's for the correct recall of FM's.
associative memories with adaptive weighted outer-products and their applications.

the following three issues: (1) how to adaptively adjust the learning weights to improve the recall performance, (2) how to adapt the SNRG's of the FMs to the corresponding learning weights, and (3) how to adapt all of the learning weights, SNRG's, and the learning rates to improve the recall of the FMs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed algorithms have the capability to recall a fundamental memory with the correct weight and the SNRG.

the learning weights and SNRG's are adaptive, the optimal values of the SNRG's can be found by a gradient-descent approach with reference to the global- or local- error measure, and that the optimal values of learning weights can be found by the gradient-descent with reference to the local-error measure.
, the learning weights and SNRG's of the proposed associative memories are not only capable of improving the recall accuracy, but also of reducing the number of iterations for correct recalls.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the adaptive weighted outer-product associative memory can recall all the stored FM's with the optimal weights and the optimal SNRG's.
, by using the adaptive weighted outer-product associative memory, the recall of the fundamental memory is improved, while the recall of the nonfundamental memory is suppressed.
the proposed associative memory can recall the FM's in the presence of noise, which is the most important advantage of the outer-product learning over other associative memories.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the adaptive weighted outer-product associative memories are able to correct some errors in recalling a fundamental memory.
the proposed adaptive weighted outer-product (AWOP) associative memory is capable of learning the optimal learning weights to recall FMs correctly, even if they have been corrupted by noise.
the proposed associative-memory neural network is capable of learning a set of FM's with the optimal learning weights and the corresponding SNRG's.
